Disables the Git Source being connected to the Remotion Studio. Clicking on stack traces and certain menu items will be disabled.

## CLI flag

Use `--disable-git-source` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                             | Flag                   |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                               | `--disable-git-source` |
| [`remotion bundle`](/docs/cli/bundle)                               | `--disable-git-source` |
| [`remotion lambda sites create`](/docs/lambda/cli/sites/create)     | `--disable-git-source` |
| [`remotion cloudrun sites create`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/sites/create) | `--disable-git-source` |
